source: Vinokurova N. Lexical Categories and Argument Structure: A Study with Reference to Sakha. Utrecht, 2005. (LOT Dissertation Series, no. 103)
notes: As (30b) shows, possessive DPs also take aax and not –LAAX. With possessives we get an interesting contrast between aax and –LAAX demonstrated in (31) which shows that a difference in the level of attachment (higher for aax and lower for -LAAX) is reflected by a difference in scope. In (31a) I know Lena and I may or may not be acquainted with her folks or the other person(s) with whom she is now whereas in (31b) I must know the whole company.
en: Lena (whom I know) and her folks / another person
